Upper bound only, ambiguous; needs the SPICE-duct lineage; as-run Table I reaches 44 cm/s.

corrected.derivation: Upper bound only ('as high as'); the sentence gives no lower bound. Agrees with the 40 cm/s maximum in R14; disagrees with the 5 to 50 cm/s of the planning SRD (R15). As-run speeds in Table I of the 2013 paper reach 44 cm/s (paragraphs 126 and 131), above this stated maximum. Lineage: the fan and the 76 mm x 76 mm duct are the SPICE apparatus (2013 paper, paragraph 51: 'The samples are burned in the SPICE apparatus which is a small flow duct with a cross-sectional area of 76mm x 76mm [Dotson et. al. 2010].'); flag SHARED_LINEAGE.

The 17 % O2 sphere test described in the guide caption is a BASS-II (PSI-25) test (O2 vitiation with GN2 was first used in BASS-II); the caption describes one test, and the guide gives 10 vs 12 cm/s for it.
Program-level result needing reduced-oxygen tests (BASS-II); cannot be attached to PSI-26 tests.

corrected.derivation: ambiguous: the 2015 ISS Researcher's Guide uses 'BASS' for the whole BASS/BASS-II campaign. A lower-oxygen result needs N2 vitiation, which the PSI-25 report says BASS-II introduced. The sentence cannot be attributed to PSI-26 tests. SHARED_LINEAGE: BASS, BASS-II, SPICE and SLICE share the MSG flow duct.

corrected.derivation: Scope sentence of the PSI Data Layout Document: says what BASS examines, not that the tests were run in microgravity. Same rule as the FLEX description-of-data sentence (PSI-69). Stronger candidates were audited and rejected or downgraded (2015 ISS Researcher's Guide pp.2, 31: they describe BASS-II or the whole campaign).

verdicts.reason: Quote verbatim at paragraph 17; past tense; SIBAL = the paper's cotton-fiberglass fabric (paper paragraph 33); exactly 12 SIBAL rows; run order and widths match the paper's Table I; As Run 44 (Test # 5b) is covered only by extension.

corrected.derivation: Abstract of PSI-26's own 2013 paper [p17], past tense, about the cotton-fiberglass fabric tests; conclusions [p186] confirm 'burned in long-duration microgravity tests aboard the ISS'. The paper says the custom-made fabric is 'sometimes referred to as SIBAL fabric' (cotton-fiberglass, 75% by mass cotton) [p33]. Scope: only the 12 PSI-26 table rows whose material is SIBAL. Their CSV 'Test #' values (1, 7, 8, 4, 10, 5, 6, 2, 3, 11, 9) match the 11 tests of the paper's Table I in the same run order and with the same widths. The exception is As Run 44 (Test # 5b, a second burn of sample 9 in opposed flow), which is not in Table I. It is covered only as a fabric burn in the same ISS campaign, not by an individual statement in the paper. Candles, spheres, PMMA, Ultem, wax and Nomex samples are not covered. The paper's 1-g comparison flames (Figs. 13-14) have no number and are not rows of the PSI table.
